claim_boundary: C015 adds six inherited hypotheses arranged in three direct funnels toward P != NP. None is proved, independently reproduced, or certified novel.

hypotheses.title: Extended-Frege Rewrite Potential Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There is an explicit polynomial-time constructible family of equivalent Boolean circuit pairs (C_n,D_n), an integer-valued polynomial-time computable potential Phi_n, and a polynomial p such that every valid step of the exact seven-gate local rewrite relation used in H035 changes Phi_n by at most p(n), while |Phi_n(C_n)-Phi_n(D_n)| is n^omega(1) p(n).
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Every rewrite chain between the endpoints has superpolynomial length. By the H035 Extended-Frege-to-rewrite simulation this yields a superpolynomial Extended Frege lower bound, hence NP != coNP and therefore P != NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_PROOF_COMPLEXITY_ROUTE: reduce a strong proof lower bound to one explicit Lipschitz potential and endpoint-gap theorem.
hypotheses.next_gate: Fix exact endpoint circuits and prove the one-step Lipschitz inequality for every clause of the seven-gate rewrite relation.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H110 supplies the invariant format demanded by H035: a computable potential, an exact per-step bound, and a superpolynomial endpoint gap, while H105 contributes the discipline of an explicit model-preserving transfer.
falsification_conditions: A valid local rewrite step changing the proposed potential by more than p(n).
A polynomial-length rewrite chain for the selected endpoints.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: No potential or endpoint family satisfying the universal inequalities is currently known.

hypotheses.title: Transparent Rewrite-Gap Composition Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There is a constant-size equivalent circuit gadget pair (A,B) and a uniform acyclic composition operator Comp such that C_n=Comp_n(A) and D_n=Comp_n(B) have syntactically transparent equivalence, polynomial size, an additive H110 potential gap n^omega(1), and no valid seven-gate rewrite step can alter more than polynomially many gadget contributions after canonical normalization.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Together with a verified local potential this constructs the explicit endpoints required by H110 and converts the Extended-Frege route to a finite gadget theorem plus a composition theorem.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: make H110 constructible by amplifying a finite local obstruction without hiding circuit equivalence in an unproved global claim.
hypotheses.next_gate: Find one gadget invariant immune to global sharing shortcuts and prove canonical normalization does not erase the additive gap.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H111 separates endpoint construction from the universal one-step inequality and demands transparent equivalence plus gap amplification from a fixed gadget.
falsification_conditions: A global rewrite shortcut changing superpolynomially many gadget contributions in one legal step.
Cancellation of the potential gap under composition.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: A finite gadget experiment cannot establish the asymptotic composition theorem.

hypotheses.title: One-Sided Certified SAT Anti-Checker Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every constant k there is a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that on input 1^n outputs a polynomial-size list of pairs (F,a), where F is a satisfiable CNF of length polynomial in n and a satisfies F, such that every Boolean circuit C of size n^k purporting to decide SAT outputs 0 on at least one listed F.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: For every k the list gives a polynomially checkable false negative against every size-n^k SAT circuit. Therefore SAT is not in P/poly and P != NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_TARGET: remove the coNP-certificate asymmetry from H031 by diagonalizing only through satisfiable false negatives with ordinary NP witnesses.
hypotheses.next_gate: Construct the list uniformly without evaluating arbitrary candidate circuits on SAT instances or assuming the desired lower bound.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H112 drops certified false positives entirely; every error certificate is just a satisfying assignment, so the remaining obstacle is uniform one-sided diagonalization rather than UNSAT certification.
falsification_conditions: For some k, polynomial-size SAT circuits output 1 on every formula produced for infinitely many n.
The constructor requires solving unrestricted circuit equivalence or SAT.
Formula lengths invalidate the circuit-size quantifier.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The executable audit verifies only the certificate asymmetry; it does not construct anti-checkers.

hypotheses.title: Range-Avoidance to One-Sided SAT Error Decoder Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There is a deterministic polynomial-time, class-preserving reduction that maps a one-bit-stretch general-circuit range-avoidance output for the truth-table map of a candidate SAT circuit to a satisfiable CNF F, an assignment a satisfying F, and a guarantee that the candidate circuit outputs 0 on F, with polynomial length and no use of an UNSAT certificate.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Any sufficiently uniform polynomial-time range-avoidance algorithm for the selected instances yields H112 anti-checkers and hence SAT not in P/poly and P != NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: convert current missing-string and range-avoidance progress into the one-sided SAT circuit error that avoids H056's negative-certificate obstruction.
hypotheses.next_gate: Define the truth-table encoding and decoder bit by bit, then prove that every missing output forces a false negative rather than an uncertified false positive.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H113 narrows H056 to a one-sided decoder and makes preservation of the SAT witness an explicit invariant of the reduction.
falsification_conditions: A valid missing-range output translating only to a false positive or no circuit error.
Superpolynomial blow-up in formula length or witness size.
A hidden NP oracle in the decoder.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Known range-avoidance lower-bound frameworks do not by themselves provide this SAT-specific one-sided decoder.

hypotheses.title: High-Girth Local-Compiler Indistinguishability Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every fixed pass bound q and rewrite radius r in H106, there are explicit polynomial-time constructible satisfiable and unsatisfiable signed CNF families whose rooted incidence neighborhoods have identical multisets through radius qr, yet any radius-qr ancestry-preserving output interpretation producing O(log n) primal treewidth cannot be both equisatisfiable and equipped with polynomial local witness recovery on the two families.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Every fixed H106 compiler is refuted by an explicit locally indistinguishable pair, eliminating a broad solve-without-global-information route to P=NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_TARGET: turn the H106 locality restriction into one explicit SAT/UNSAT lift pair and a treewidth-output contradiction.
hypotheses.next_gate: Construct a signed high-girth lift pair with opposite satisfiability and prove exact rooted-neighborhood equality rather than heuristic similarity.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H114 selects the concrete lower-bound object missing from H106: opposite-label formulas that no fixed-radius ancestry map can distinguish locally.
falsification_conditions: A valid H106 compiler distinguishing every proposed lift pair within radius qr.
A global witness-recovery channel compatible with the stated ancestry restriction.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The local-neighborhood self-test checks only finite signatures and does not construct the required asymptotic SAT/UNSAT family.

hypotheses.title: Locality-to-Treewidth Obstruction Transfer Lemma Candidate
hypotheses.statement: Assume an H114 pair for constants q,r and an H106 compiler whose output symbols and recovery annotations are isomorphism-invariant functions of rooted signed neighborhoods of radius at most qr. Then the two outputs have the same bounded-radius type inventory and recovery behavior; if both outputs have O(log n) treewidth and polynomial size, a canonical dynamic program plus the local recovery annotations cannot return opposite correct SAT decisions, contradicting equisatisfiability.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: H114 would mechanically destroy every compiler in the exact H106 class, closing the locality funnel without proving a lower bound against unrestricted polynomial-time algorithms.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_BRIDGE: isolate the transfer theorem needed to turn local indistinguishability into a contradiction with low-treewidth decision and recovery.
hypotheses.next_gate: Formalize the compiler as an isomorphism-invariant finite interpretation and prove the output decomposition and recovery transcript depend only on the registered type inventory.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H115 separates construction of hard local twins from the semantic theorem that low-treewidth output plus local recovery cannot distinguish them.
falsification_conditions: An H106-legal interpretation whose low-treewidth outputs differ globally despite identical local type inventories.
A recovery annotation using information not captured by radius-qr ancestry.
A flaw in canonicalizing the treewidth dynamic program.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The lemma is conditional on an exact H114 pair and a formally fixed interpretation model.
